title: The Bellows' Breath
text: The forge's great bellows still breathe somewhere deep below, blowing blasts of hot air through the tunnels like the sighs of a sleeping giant. Each gust singes hair and cracks lips. The frailest of you will feel it most.

options.label: Shelter the frailest behind a shield, and brace against the blasts.

outcomes.text: They come through, red-faced and gasping. The shield does not, and neither does the arm that held it.

options.label: The strongest jams the bellows shut, and silences the giant's breathing.

outcomes.text: The forge falls quiet, and the tunnels go cold and still, and very dark.
The forge's keeper notices that its breath has stopped, and comes to see why.

options.label: Count the blasts, and run between them, trusting your timing.

outcomes.text: Between one breath and the next, across, with singed hair and pounding hearts.
